temperature_domain.low_temperature_support: Below 313.15 K; speciation support without matching admitted pCO2 coverage, but still inside the current R4/R5 source domain where applicable.
temperature_domain.reaction_domain_extension: 323.15-353.15 K data enter the joint fit only after S5 qualifies new R4/R5 coefficients over that domain.
temperature_domain.high_temperature_challenge: Above 353.15 K; withheld from the first joint fit until reaction-correlation and model domains are qualified.

selection_policy.model_selection: Five-fold campaign-blocked cross-validation over every admissible row after source-backed residual scales and immutable packet identity are frozen; current rows are candidate partitions only.
selection_policy.final_estimation: After model form and active coordinates are frozen, refit on all admissible in-domain rows.
selection_policy.claim_boundary: Cross-validation supports transfer assessment; all-data residuals support calibration assessment only.
selection_policy.residual_scaling: Use source uncertainty in the reported basis. When unavailable, acquire or preregister a source/method-backed scale before execution; do not tune scales against fit quality.
selection_policy.acceptance: Assess pCO2, speciation, volumetric, dielectric, and activity families separately; no single aggregate objective can promote a model.
selection_policy.uncertainty: Use rank and conditioning first, then profile likelihoods and campaign-blocked bootstrap where computationally feasible.

stages.name: Freeze data and Engine identities
stages.data: Canonical source rows, measurement roles, campaign blocks, reaction sources, and immutable Data-packet and Engine-wheel identities.
stages.gate: No unresolved basis, model-derived target, unbounded censor, duplicate derivative, mutable sibling import, or unhashed source file.

stages.name: Qualify the retained neutral pure-component family
active_coordinates: source-justified fixed-topology association energy and volume
stages.data: Pure saturation and fixed-state pressure-at-measured-density observations, grouped by source and temperature.
stages.gate: BLOCKED until the pure-MEA measurement package is complete and the retained water and MEA association family is qualified on independent pure and binary observations.

stages.name: Fit neutral binary interactions with induced association fixed
active_coordinates: one k_ij at a time for MEA-H2O, CO2-H2O, and CO2-MEA
l_ij only when profile rank supports it
stages.data: Binary MEA-H2O VLE, physical CO2 solubility, neutral mixture density, and association-sensitive evidence.
stages.gate: Engine phase-equilibrium observations are admitted. Complete the MEA-H2O and physical CO2-water fits under the fixed association topology before reactive fitting.

stages.name: Certify the homogeneous reactive tracer
stages.fixed: All parameters and reaction correlations from the selected neutral configuration.
stages.data: Admissible fixed-T,P speciation and neutral-fugacity tracer rows.
stages.gate: Engine issue #30 is admitted. The installed-wheel MEA run is a mathematical and sensitivity tracer only; it is not VLE evidence or parameter promotion.

stages.name: Constrain the target ionic pair
active_coordinates: MEAH+ dispersion_energy_over_k only if profiles separate it from size
stages.data: Direct and aggregate speciation plus source-qualified same-state volumetric evidence; analog salts remain analog constraints.
stages.gate: Require exact counterion ownership, source-backed priors where needed, full-rank Jacobian, acceptable conditioning, and profile-likelihood support.

stages.name: Fit true reactive bubble and VLE observations
stages.active_coordinates: Only the smallest ionic block identified by S4 rank and profiles; never reopen every parameter family together.
stages.fixed: Frozen model configuration, qualified neutral blocks, and source-backed R1-R5 correlations.
stages.data: Admissible pCO2, total pressure or vapor composition when direct, and same-state speciation across the qualified domain.
stages.gate: Engine issue #31 is admitted. Application scoring remains blocked until pressure/speciation rows have complete state and residual-scale contracts and S1-S4 pass.

stages.name: Review reaction correlations after EOS qualification
active_coordinates: R4 A/B/C/D candidate coefficients only if independently identifiable
R5 A/B/C/D candidate coefficients only if independently identifiable
fixed: selected EOS, association, ionic, Born, and permittivity parameters
stages.data: Grouped multi-temperature direct or declared aggregate speciation, calibrated equilibrium pH when acquired, and pCO2.
stages.gate: Retain source R1-R5 initially. Activate coefficients only for systematic residuals that remain after physical-model qualification and only when rank, profiles, and held-out temperatures support them; never absorb EOS or activity errors.

stages.name: Select, refit, quantify uncertainty, and promote
stages.data: All admissible in-domain observations for the final refit after cross-validated model selection.
stages.gate: Require all-row accounting, campaign-blocked residual structure, multistart agreement, no unsupported active bounds, rank and conditioning, profile likelihoods, campaign-blocked bootstrap where feasible, immutable packet and wheel fingerprints, and one promoted primary parameter set.

global_rules: Loading is a state input, never a fitted observation.
Heat of absorption remains excluded until a source-complete definition and Engine observation family exist.
No generic numeric failure penalty may be reported as an evaluated model residual.
No regularization is admitted without a named source-backed prior identity and scale.
The manuscript remains unchanged until the final predictive gates pass.
